B. Atomic layer deposition
ALD Al2O3 films were grown at 300 1C in a Picosun R-150 ALD reactor. The target thickness was typically ca. 50 nm made in 500 ALD cycles. The process pressure was ca. 3 hPa. Nitrogen (purity 6.0) with a constant flow rate of 150 sccm was used as the carrier and purge gas through four reactant lines. Similar to earlier studies, a TMA-purge-water-purge sequence (s) of 0.1–4.0–0.1–4.0 was typically used.
